title: 5G NR LDPC real-time and research enablers
description:
## Goal

Bring up 5G NR LDPC as the headline benchmark for the `gf2-sim`
pipeline: BG1 + BG2 with all 8 lifting sets, rates
{1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6}, tuned to a concrete real-time decode rate
target on gfx1030. Add a comparison harness against aff3ct / IT++
and ship researcher onboarding examples.

## Context

Story under epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Sequencing-blocked on
the DVB-T2 application story (proves the pipeline at production
scale). Existing memory entry flags per-`i_LS` correctness as a
known trap — the BG-table task must verify against 3GPP TS 38.212.

**Real-time target made concrete 2026-06-07 post-audit (user-
approved per Q2)**: at least one configuration meets
**BG1, `i_LS` = 8 (Z = 384), rate 1/2, BLER ≤ 10⁻², single layer,
decoded TB throughput ≥ 200 Mbps on gfx1030**, at NR numerology
μ = 1 (30 kHz SCS, 14 OFDM symbols per slot, 273 PRBs reference).
The 200 Mbps figure is the research-grade bar above DVB-T2 by
~50× and within gfx1030's RDNA2 envelope per the
adversarial-review feasibility analysis. **(Superseded 2026-06-12b:
study `43fb19e2` measured the kernel bandwidth-bound at 44% of
peak VRAM — 200 Mbps is unreachable on gfx1030; the criterion below
was amended, user-approved option B, to the attested flat-kernel
measurement.)**

## Deliverables (themes)

- 5G NR LDPC base graphs (BG1, BG2) + per-`i_LS` shift tables,
  verified vs 3GPP TS 38.212 for rates {1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6}.
- 5G NR preset (typestate builder).
- GPU LDPC BP kernel tuning to real-time decode rate on gfx1030;
  documented measurement vs spec PRB rates for the canonical
  configuration above.
- Comparison harness vs aff3ct / IT++ on a shared benchmark
  suite (DVB-T2 + 5G NR LDPC AWGN curves).
- Researcher onboarding: `examples/`, rustdoc walk-throughs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All child tasks complete with required gates green.
- [hard] Real-time decode-rate measurement attested on BG1,
  `i_LS` = 1 / Z = 384, rate 1/2, BLER ≤ 10⁻²: the flat-kernel
  ceiling of 17.45 ± 0.03 Mbps decoded TB throughput on gfx1030,
  with documented receipt under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/5g-nr-realtime.md`. (AMENDED
  2026-06-12b, user-approved option B extended to this story
  2026-06-12: the original ≥ 200 Mbps bar is unreachable on
  gfx1030 — bandwidth-bound per study `43fb19e2`, 50–83 Mbps
  headroom via kernel work deferred to a future epic; the
  original `i_LS` = 8 label was a bug — Z = 384 is set
  `i_LS` = 1.)
- [hard] aff3ct / IT++ comparison curves on at least one
  DVB-T2 and one 5G NR configuration committed under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/comparison/`.
- [hard] Onboarding examples + rustdoc cover both the DVB-T2 and
  5G NR presets via the typestate builder.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals; turbo, polar, and fading-channel
extensions are out of scope.
